title: Introducing Multiple Templates, Improved Projects, and AI-Assisted Bidding
summary: Cogram expands its Templates feature to support multiple custom templates for different meeting types, improves the Projects interface, and is developing AI-powered tools for RFP processing and proposal drafting.
body_markdown:
This post records a December 2024 release. The interface and setup steps described here may have changed.


## Templates: Export Minutes in Multiple Templates


This release expanded the Templates feature for exporting meeting minutes. Teams could set up custom templates for on-site field reports, design meetings, OAC meetings, and project-specific formats.


For the current meeting-minutes workflow, see[Meeting Minutes](https://cogram.com/meeting-minutes) , which describes drafts in a firm's templates.


## Improvements to Cogram's Meeting Page: Review and Edit Notes Easily


The release added a transcript view alongside Cogram's notes to support review and verification. It also added Search and Replace for corrections across a meeting.


## Projects: Create and Manage Projects Easily


The release added separate rules for meetings and email threads, with assignment based on keywords or participants. Colleagues could be invited to access a project, export documentation, and add notes.


## Looking Ahead: AI-Assisted Proposals and RFP Review


In December 2024, we described RFP processing and proposal drafting as work in development. That announcement should not be read as a description of current product scope. The product formerly called AI Assistant is now[Agent](https://cogram.com/agent) ; see that page for its current connected-project-information workflow.
